python3 - <<'PY'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/resources/filter.rs'
s=open(p).read()

NOTE = ('    // The published parameters are cleared immediately, so they are non-zero for exactly the\n'
        '    // duration of one application. The legacy per-descriptor path (which still serves `zlib.*` and\n'
        '    // `bzip2.*`) calls the same applier without a node, and a `line-length` left behind by an\n'
        '    // unrelated chain would silently wrap ITS output.\n')

old='''    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_apply_stream_filter");                         // transform in place; x2 = new length
    emitter.instruction("str x2, [sp, #8]");                                    // carry the new length to the next node'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_apply_stream_filter");                         // transform in place; x2 = new length
    emitter.instruction("str x2, [sp, #8]");                                    // carry the new length to the next node
''' + NOTE + '''    emitter.instruction("mov x0, #0");
    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_asf_params_load");                             // clear them again'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)

old='''    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length
    emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 40], rdx");                       // the new length outlives the clear
''' + NOTE + '''    emitter.instruction("xor edi, edi");
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_asf_params_load");                           // clear them again
    emitter.instruction("mov rdx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 40]");                       // and carry the length onward'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('params are cleared after each application')
